_comment: Every page of the book, in order, correctly rotated.
The parts tables are included AS PAGES rather than as data. The book is a
2012 photocopy and OCR of it is not trustworthy: checked against the print,
6 of 22 rows on page 2 came back wrong - 401.100.00 for 101.100.00,
DIN 934 for DIN 931, position 64 for 61. A parts list that wrong is worse
than none, because somebody orders the wrong part from it. As images the
tables are exactly what the book says, and they are legible on a phone.
rotate is anticlockwise degrees. Only page 1 needs it: its drawing is set
sideways on an upright page, so -90 turns it back.
